| description = Can occasionally see invis! Always /con these guys.

Getting these alone as a Bard solo proved difficult. I found a safe place where both zealots and fanatics would spawn (along with other types), however. Heading into the courtyard go into the second door on the left. Continue to go left through a couple passages until you get to several long hallways that lead to the avatar pyramid (#1). There is a lone room down here where three lizards spawn. It is fairly easy to pull them separately and fear kite them in the long hallway.
